# Frontend Masters

> > Expert-led web development training platform covering JavaScript, React, TypeScript, Node.js, CSS, HTML, and full-stack development through 250+ professional courses.

Frontend Masters offers comprehensive learning paths from beginner to senior developer level, featuring instructors from companies like Netflix, Vercel, and Databricks. The platform includes live workshops, tutorials, certificates, and both free and premium subscription options for individual developers and teams.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript
- React
- TypeScript
- Node.js
- CSS
- HTML
- Frontend Development
- Full-Stack Development
- Web Performance
- Learning Paths
- Live Workshops
- AI & Machine Learning
- Python
- Next.js
- Git & Version Control

## Getting Started

- [Frontend Masters Home](https://frontendmasters.com): Homepage: Full-stack training from frontend to backend with 250+ courses
- [Free Bootcamp](https://frontendmasters.com/bootcamp): Free bootcamp teaching HTML, CSS & JavaScript through project-based learning
- [Free Account](https://frontendmasters.com/free): Free account offering 5 professional courses on HTML, CSS & JavaScript
- [Learning Paths](https://frontendmasters.com/learn): Curated learning paths from beginner to senior developer level
- [Platform Features](https://frontendmasters.com/features): Platform features: 250+ courses, learning paths, certificates & workshops

## Course Catalog & Learning Resources

- [All Courses](https://frontendmasters.com/courses): Complete course catalog covering JavaScript, React, TypeScript, Node.js & more
- [Live Workshops](https://frontendmasters.com/workshops): Live-streamed workshops with instructors like Evgenii Ray & Brian Holt
- [Tutorials](https://frontendmasters.com/tutorials): Short creator-led tutorials on CSS, JavaScript, React, TypeScript & more
- [Full Stack Tutorials](https://frontendmasters.com/tutorials/full-stack): Full-stack tutorials for building end-to-end web applications
- [Artificial Intelligence Courses](https://frontendmasters.com/topics/artificial-intelligence): AI & machine learning courses covering agents, TensorFlow & neural networks

## Featured Courses

- [Everything You Need to Know About Git](https://frontendmasters.com/courses/everything-git): Comprehensive Git course by ThePrimeagen covering rebase, bisect & reflog
- [Front-end Interview Preparation](https://frontendmasters.com/courses/interviewing-frontend): Jem Young's course on passing frontend interviews at companies like Netflix
- [JavaScript Performance Techniques](https://frontendmasters.com/courses/web-performance): Steve Kinney teaches JavaScript optimization, rendering & Webpack techniques
- [Enterprise DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure](https://frontendmasters.com/courses/enterprise-devops/introduction): Erik Reinert introduces enterprise DevOps & cloud infrastructure course
- [Practical Machine Learning with TensorFlow](https://frontendmasters.com/courses/practical-machine-learning/introduction): Vadim Karpusenko introduces practical ML with TensorFlow 2.0 & Keras
- [Practical Algorithms with JavaScript](https://frontendmasters.com/courses/practical-algorithms/faster-algorithms): Bianca Gandolfo teaches algorithm optimization through caching techniques
- [Practical Python Guide](https://frontendmasters.com/courses/practical-python/methods-magic-methods): Nina covers Python class methods, magic methods & decorators
- [Engineering Management Fundamentals](https://frontendmasters.com/courses/intro-management/truths-about-engineering-management): Lesson on engineering management truths by Jem from management course

## Learning Guides & References

- [Front-End Developer Learning Roadmap](https://frontendmasters.com/guides/learning-roadmap): Comprehensive frontend learning roadmap covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript & more
- [Front-end Developer Handbook 2019](https://frontendmasters.com/guides/front-end-handbook/2019): Cody Lindley's comprehensive 2019 frontend developer handbook & guide
- [Complete Guide to Beginning with JavaScript](https://frontendmasters.com/blog/a-complete-guide-to-beginning-with-javascript): Cody Lindley's comprehensive JavaScript beginner guide with prerequisites
- [Complete Guide to Beginning with TypeScript](https://frontendmasters.com/blog/a-complete-guide-to-beginning-with-typescript): Cody Lindley's TypeScript beginner guide covering prerequisites & resources
- [Advanced CSS Media Queries](https://frontendmasters.com/blog/learn-media-queries): Daniel Schwarz explores advanced CSS media queries beyond basic breakpoints
